# coreapp-v1_cluster_topo_link (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) ClusterTopoLinkSpec defines the desired state of ClusterTopoLink.
ClusterTopoLink represents a logical link between TopoNodes that may reside in different namespaces.
All members on one side of the link must be in the same namespace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `alarms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarms))
- `api_version` (String)
- `deviations` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deviations))
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String) name of the ClusterTopoLink
- `status` (Attributes) ClusterTopoLinkStatus defines the observed state of ClusterTopoLink. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
